user.title: Add music light
user.description: Create one entry per light and give each entry a different UDP port. In LedFx, add a DDP device with 1 pixel and destination ID 1, directed to the Home Assistant IP and this UDP port. The optional PC IP restricts which source may send frames. No HA token is needed.

data.name: Name
data.port: DDP UDP port on Home Assistant
data.host: LedFx PC IPv4 address (optional source filter)

init.title: Synchronization settings
init.description: Defaults: up to 20 action starts per second, 4 concurrent actions. Frames arriving while busy replace older frames. More starts do not guarantee faster physical Tuya updates. The sync switch restores its last state after a restart; the default below applies when no previous state exists.
